summary: Iteration 13 (5 AI-moat features + Field tab bug fix) PASSES end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 functional tests green (test_iter13_ai_tools = 11 pass + 1 GPT-4o E2E correctly skipped by default; test_iter12_field = 17/17 pass — Field regression preserved). Backend regression iter11_collab = 23/23 pass. Schedule endpoint POST/GET fully validated incl. critical-path content (phases 0,3,5,14 always critical), sqft/crew scaling, 422 on out-of-range. AI floorplan validation (prompt length 4-600) + 403 non-member access enforced. Frontend (Playwright on https://build-ai-147.preview.emergentagent.com): admin login → dashboard, all 7 tabs present (documents/materials/blueprint/cad/renderer/field/schedule). Field tab: all 4 sub-tabs (log/photos/progress/lidar) mount without React crash, addressing iter12 regression where photos/progress/lidar were unreachable. Daily-log SUBMIT returned HTTP 200 (no 422), log row visible in data-testid=daily-log-list with correct crew/notes, ZERO console errors, ZERO 'Objects are not valid as a React child' crashes — both iter12 fixes (errText helper + Boolean() coercion on fetch_weather) verified live. Note: Auto-fetch checkbox was 'checked + disabled' (UI shows '· capture a site first') when no site captured — submit still succeeded because backend silently skips weather. Schedule tab: sched-generate produced schedule-result with 15 sched-bar-* entries, schedule-svg contains both #FF3333 (critical) and #FFCC00 (with-float) colors, phase-details <details> renders sched-table. CAD AI panel mounted as overlay (cad-ai-panel), tab switch cad-ai-tab-ai ↔ cad-ai-tab-code works, prompt textarea renders. Renderer tab: renderer-studio-render and renderer-walkthrough buttons present in top-right with correct title tooltips ('Render high-resolution 4K still' / 'Record 16s walkthrough video (webm)'), both correctly DISABLED on empty blueprint (admin's TEST_iter11_251594 project had 0 walls). Documents/Materials/Blueprint regression tabs mount with zero React crash errors.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: ai_tools.py compute_schedule() uses proper forward-pass + backward-pass with slack < 0.01 threshold for critical-path tagging; deterministic, fast (<1ms), and the PHASE_PLAN dependency DAG matches sceneBuilder.js construction sequence — single source of truth.

GOOD: _sanitize_floorplan() defensively coerces every wall/door/window/label field to expected types with try/except — protects against GPT returning numeric strings or malformed structures; caps each array (walls:60, doors/windows:40, labels:30) to bound DB writes.

GOOD: ai_floorplan endpoint properly chains require_role → wait_for(60s) → _sanitize → 422 if no walls → blueprint upsert with wall_index re-offset for appended items, plus activity log. Clean separation between LLM call and persistence.

GOOD: FieldTab errText helper flattens FastAPI 422 array detail (each {msg,loc,...}) into a join string — prevents React crash and gives readable error toasts. Boolean(fetch_weather) coercion before POST eliminates the truthy-non-bool 422 case verified in iter12 report.

GOOD: ScheduleTab.jsx renders critical-path bars in #FF3333 vs #FFCC00 (no-color-only accessibility risk because phase labels are text + duration day count is also colored — slight accessibility miss for color-blind users but acceptable given legend below chart).
MINOR: ai_tools.py PHASE_PLAN backward-pass at line 145 uses 'phases[s]["start_day"] + 0' — the +0 is dead code, presumably an early-finish offset intent; harmless but should be removed for clarity.

MINOR: ScheduleTab.jsx line 56 — error array .map((x) => x.msg) assumes each item is dict with .msg; if FastAPI ever returns nested structure (e.g., ctx with sub-objects) this could re-introduce a render crash. Consider using JSON.stringify fallback like FieldTab.errText does.

MINOR: pytest mark.slow is not registered in pytest.ini/pyproject — produces PytestUnknownMarkWarning. Register in pyproject [tool.pytest.ini_options] markers = ['slow: tests that hit external LLMs'] to silence.

MINOR: Daily-log form: fetch_weather checkbox displays as 'checked + disabled' when no site captured — visually misleading (user thinks weather will be fetched). Consider rendering it as 'unchecked + disabled' since backend ignores the request anyway.

success_rate.backend: 100% (28/28 functional, 1 LLM-skipped by design; 23/23 iter11 regression)

seed_data_creation: Conftest creates ephemeral test_a_*/test_b_* users + per-test projects; iter13 schedule tests share one TEST_iter13_* project across the class. Frontend tests reused the admin's pre-existing TEST_iter11_251594 project (empty blueprint, ideal for the renderer disabled-state assertion).

To exercise the GPT-4o floorplan E2E, set RUN_LLM_TESTS=1 (5-15s call, costs ~$0.05).
